metadata.method: GitHub API search + manual curation, ≥20 repos, quality-filtered

tier_legend.1: 方法专家仓 (core BEM methodology: acoustics/EM/potential flow solvers with Green functions, H-matrix, FMM acceleration)
tier_legend.2: 可微/框架族 (differentiable, modern framework, cross-platform, JIT-compiled)
tier_legend.3: 专项能力 (specialized capability: education, geomechanics, niche physics, converters)

repositories.summary: Python BEM solver for linear potential flow based on Nemoh; computes hydrodynamic coefficients (added mass, radiation damping, diffraction forces) for marine structures; active development with conda distribution.

Fast Python JIT-compiling BEM library; supports acoustics, electromagnetics, Laplace, Helmholtz; Numba-accelerated; modern API with grid functions, operators, and solvers; extensive documentation and tutorials.
Comprehensive BEM suite for electromagnetic scattering, Casimir forces, fluctuation-induced phenomena; MPI-parallel; handles complex geometries; includes GUI and post-processing tools.
Open-source MLFMA (Multi-Level Fast Multipole Algorithm) for electromagnetic scattering; computes radar cross-section; MPI-parallel; production-grade for large-scale EM problems.
Hydrodynamic coefficients viewer and converter for BEM solver formats (WAMIT, Moses, Hydrostar, DAVE, Moses); GUI-based; essential tool for marine hydrodynamics workflow.
Boundary Element Analysis and Simulation Toolkit in Julia; modern language features; supports electromagnetics and acoustics; symbolic manipulation capabilities; active development.
Blade Element Momentum Theory implementation for turbines and propellers; Python-based; educational and engineering applications; includes validation cases.
Kernel-independent fast multipole method library with Python interface; supports multiple kernel types; designed for exascale computing; tree-based algorithms.
Parallel Boundary Element Method solver; MPI-distributed; C++ implementation; focuses on scalability and performance for large-scale BEM problems.
MATLAB toolbox for fast numerical computation with FEM and BEM; includes fast solvers; research-oriented; educational value for understanding BEM implementation.
Black-box fast multipole method package for Python; kernel-independent; easy to use; suitable for rapid prototyping of BEM-FMM coupled solvers.
BEM MATLAB code for modelling faults and deformation in geomechanics; educational; includes examples and documentation; active maintenance.
Fast Multipole Method library in R^3; Fortran implementation; supports Laplace, Helmholtz, Stokes kernels; high-performance; widely used as backend for BEM solvers.
ABAQUS polyhedral user element based on scaled boundary FEM; bridges BEM and FEM; specialized for fracture mechanics; research-grade.
Python-based 2D BEM library; educational focus; implements Laplace and elasticity problems; clean code structure suitable for learning BEM fundamentals.
Implementation of 'Surface-Only Dynamic Deformables using BEM'; computer graphics application; demonstrates BEM for real-time deformation; research prototype.
2D flow solver with GUI using vortex particle and BEM methods; interactive; educational and research tool for potential flow problems.
Computational geometry foundations for FEM and BEM in Julia; mesh generation and manipulation; essential infrastructure for Julia BEM ecosystem.
BEM toolbox for metallic nanoparticle simulation; plasmonics and nanophotonics; MATLAB-based; specialized for quantum and classical EM at nanoscale.
BEM code for solving acoustic equations; Jupyter-based; educational focus; implements Helmholtz equation solver; includes examples and documentation.
Open-source package for computation of free-surface Green's function under finite water depth; essential component for marine hydrodynamics BEM solvers.
Simple package for solving boundary integral equations using collocation BEM in Julia; educational focus; clean implementation; good for learning BIE methods.
Fast, flexible, multi-kernel, multi-system FMM implementation in Julia; modern language; supports various kernel types; active development.
Boundary element methods in Rust; performance and safety focus; modern language; emerging ecosystem; potential for high-performance BEM applications.
Task-based FMM parallelized with OpenMP and StarPU; supports multiple GPUs via CUDA; high-performance; research-grade implementation.
BEM for acoustics; Jupyter-based; educational focus; implements acoustic BEM solver; includes tutorials and examples.
Fast approximations for boundary element based brittle fracture simulation; reduced basis methods; research-grade; focuses on computational efficiency.
Lightweight BEM library for hydrodynamics and aerodynamics; C++ implementation; focuses on simplicity and ease of use; suitable for engineering applications.
Coupled boundary layer theory / potential theory BEM solver for incompressible flow around airfoils; MATLAB-based; educational and research tool.
Triangulation, BEM, FMM code for Python; NIST ion storage application; educational value; demonstrates BEM-FMM coupling.

GAP-BEM-1.title: 可微分BEM求解器
GAP-BEM-1.problem: 现有开源BEM库（除BEAST.jl外）缺乏原生自动微分支持，无法直接嵌入梯度优化/反问题/UQ流程
GAP-BEM-1.opportunity: 基于JAX/PyTorch构建可微BEM内核，支持Green函数/积分算子的自动微分，服务于形状优化/参数反演

GAP-BEM-2.title: H-matrix/FMM加速的工业级BEM
GAP-BEM-2.problem: 开源BEM多为教学/研究级，缺乏生产级H-matrix/FMM加速（Puma-EM仅限电磁学）
GAP-BEM-2.opportunity: 构建通用H-matrix库（支持Laplace/Helmholtz/Stokes核），与现有BEM求解器解耦，提供Python/C++接口

GAP-BEM-3.title: 船舶水动力BEM基准验证面
GAP-BEM-3.problem: Capytaine基于Nemoh但缺乏系统性验证面（解析解/实验数据对标），精度声明不充分
GAP-BEM-3.opportunity: 建立船舶水动力BEM基准库：Wigley船型/ Series 60等解析解+实验数据，自动化回归测试，精度<3%判据

GAP-BEM-4.title: GPU加速BEM内核
GAP-BEM-4.problem: 现有开源BEM几乎无GPU实现（bempp-rs有潜力但未成熟），大规模问题性能受限
GAP-BEM-4.opportunity: 基于CUDA/HIP实现BEM核心积分/Green函数计算，支持Helmholtz/Laplace/Stokes核，与FMM耦合

GAP-BEM-5.title: 多物理场BEM耦合框架
GAP-BEM-5.problem: 声学/电磁/势流BEM各自独立，缺乏统一框架支持FEM-BEM耦合/多物理场
GAP-BEM-5.opportunity: 构建模块化BEM框架：统一网格/算子/求解器接口，支持声学-结构/电磁-热/势流-弹性耦合

GAP-BEM-6.title: 自由面Green函数高效计算
GAP-BEM-6.problem: FinGreen3D等实现老旧，缺乏现代优化（向量化/GPU），计算效率低
GAP-BEM-6.opportunity: 重写自由面Green函数库：现代Fortran/C++/Python接口，支持有限/无限水深，向量化+GPU加速

GAP-BEM-7.title: BEM网格质量与自适应
GAP-BEM-7.problem: 开源BEM缺乏自适应网格细化/误差估计，用户需手动调网格
GAP-BEM-7.opportunity: 实现基于后验误差估计的自适应BEM：支持h/p自适应，与求解器解耦，提供Python接口

GAP-BEM-8.title: BEM与机器学习集成
GAP-BEM-8.problem: BEM求解器与ML框架（PyTorch/JAX）集成困难，无法利用神经网络加速/代理模型
GAP-BEM-8.opportunity: 构建BEM-ML桥接层：BEM算子导出为PyTorch模块，支持神经网络代理模型/物理信息神经网络(PINN)混合求解
